verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical and share the same flaws. The product image is shrunk into a small top-right circle. The 'Find It Near You' CTA is a tiny pill set beside the badges instead of standing out, and it comes before the body copy, which sits stranded at the bottom right, so the reading order is broken. Elements are scattered in a two-column grid with large dead gaps, the 'Free Delivery' tag lands mid-canvas, and the 'BACKBY DEMAND' label loses its space. B differs only by sub-pixel shifts.
